Fresh independent Python perfect-matching enumeration, 24-face transition enumeration and all-pairs BFS: 3108 states, 9048 edges, 15 sectors; complete sector summaries and 163 nonzero distance bins.
correctness.rationale: For C4 square C6 with exactly 24 embedded faces (seam faces included), the least-uncovered-vertex matching recursion is exhaustive and injective; face-mask replacement enumerates exactly legal flips. Graph traversal and BFS from every vertex establish distance histograms, eccentricities, radii, diameters and componentwise Wiener sums. Independently reconstructed 3,108 matchings, 9,048 undirected flip edges, 15 flux-separated connected components and all component (size,edge,radius,diameter,Wiener) profiles; in flux (0,0) recovered (1456,4968,12,20,8146752), aggregate Wiener 10795608 and 163 nonzero distance bins. Signed seam flux is invariant; complete finite enumeration shows each nonempty class connected, not a generic toroidal theorem.
residual_risks: Independent code verifies the finite C4xC6 object only; no statement for higher tori.
